about.title: So, who am I?
paragraphs: Just a guy who enjoys building things, breaking things, and occasionally fixing the things he broke.
Interested in technology, software, design, business, and figuring out how stuff works.
I don’t really have a master plan. I just learn things, try things, mess things up, and somehow figure things out along the way.
about.facts_tag: A FEW USELESS FACTS ABOUT ME
facts: Has too many ideas. Send help.
Learns by doing. Occasionally by making mistakes.
Can turn “I wonder if this works” into an unnecessarily long project.

projects.title: LOOK! I ACTUALLY MADE SOMETHING.

skills.title: THINGS I CAN DO (WITHOUT PANICKING).
skills.intro: Not a list of superpowers. Just things I’ve learned, used, broken, and occasionally mastered.
skills.super_text: Learning things without waiting for someone to explain them first.
skills.super_note: Jack of some trades. Master of figuring things out.

experience.title: PLACES WHERE I WAS USEFUL.
experience.intro: I’ve worked with people, businesses, products, processes, and probably more spreadsheets than any human should.

jobs.title: SUPERVISOR
paragraphs: Joined as the first employee and grew alongside the business, working closely with its founders and co-founder.
Contributed to business operations and organizational growth, helping support a workforce of 50+ employees by 2023.
list: Supervising teams and improving work methods.
Manufacturing facility layout and workflow planning.
K3, halal procedures, and GMP implementation.
jobs.note: Started as employee number one. Somehow ended up helping keep the whole thing running.

jobs.title: DATA RESEARCH & ANALYSIS
paragraphs: Worked independently on survey-related research, respondent analysis, and sensitive data projects.
jobs.note: Some details are better left off the internet. You’re welcome.

jobs.title: FREELANCE & INDEPENDENT WORK
paragraphs: Worked on graphic design, logo design, apparel graphics, screen printing, and creative projects for small businesses, organizations, and communities.
Also experimented with an independent culinary business.
jobs.note: Basically, I was trying things. A lot of things.
